title: Seed library marks five years of lending in Ashgrove
text: The Thornwood Seed Library was founded in 2014 and has lent seed to Ashgrove gardeners every season since. Two paid staff keep the catalogue in order, supported by a rota of volunteers who clean and package donations through the winter. The library now holds more than forty vegetable and herb varieties, most of them collected from growers within the valley. Its spring seed swap, held each April in the parish hall, has become the largest event in the group's calendar.
